brief: A mobile-first status board that answers one question for Quezon City University students - is class on today? Calm, truthful, institutional; a public-service tool, not a consumer app.
criteria: Success: says QCU + time in one glyph, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, calm and trustworthy.

concepts.name: Q Hour
concepts.idea: The Q is a clock face and its tail is the hand - QCU, built around time.
rationale: Says QCU and 'now' in a single mark - no second element needed
Carries equity from the old Q-and-hand icon, resolved cleanly
Holds its silhouette down to 16 px; strong as a favicon and app tile
Blue + gold reads as QCU; flat and calm, matching the status-board voice

recommendation: Q Hour, in QCU blue with a gold hand. One idea, legible everywhere, and unmistakably QCU.
next_steps: Outline the wordmark in Public Sans for final masters
Wire the favicon + app-icon set into the web app
Optional: colour-highlight the current class block in-product
